The scatter plot above gives the correspondence between the variables $x$ and $y$ for some data points.
Use the trend line to predict the value of $y$ when $x=70.$
question.worked_solution:
To make our prediction, we proceed as follows:

- First, we start at $x=70$ on the $x$-axis.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14227574/assets/ee670899ebf962939a77959c58219502907681d8cf84329f402b67f6f09a24ba.png)

* Then, we move up until we intersect the trend line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14227574/assets/f6d34d0c6b95b4b3d5ecf720346ca1e0008ac86c42e8024a2435e2bf792e5031.png)

- Finally, we move left until we intersect the $y$-axis.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14227574/assets/0217edcb171859f1aec207d5c248c483a3147dbe74aed277f1313009dbc317c9.png)

Therefore, when $x=70,$ we obtain $y≈5.$
